site_name: Flat A, 7 Ladbroke Gardens, LONDON, W11 2PT
description: Alterations to front lightwell to install new basement level lightwell with painted metal balustrade, painted timber sash window at basement level, flushed rooflight over coal chute, and new painted timber entrance door with glazed fanlight. Excavation of rear garden to enable erection of 3m deep rear extension and patio with roof terrace, 2no. flushed rooflights, painted metal balustrade and steps, and 2no. aluminium-framed sliding doors. Installation of new painted timber sash window on rear elevation in enlarged window opening. Installation of new rear garden hard landscaping and steps to communal garden. Internal refurbishments and alterations to enable dwelling to be habitable, including lowering of finished floor levels at basement level.
